nodes.title: Round 7 F (learning-parent-teaching-page): /parent/teaching ('How {T} teaches {child}', linked from More) shows: how the teacher works (fixed copy, the same for every child); per recent lesson (last 5 counted), what she did and why, from brain_trace's closed codes through a fixed lexicon (server/reports/teaching.js: the child's own requests such as a slower pace or a picture, then reteach / worked example / hint / teach-back / on-screen piece / warm-up / break, at most 4 lines, fixed priority); the made-for pieces with their kit 'because'; and What {T} remembers with Delete (the Data page's card). No model text and no statement about the child's mind, ability or style; every line passes the report lexicon (tests/r7-learning-teaching). Not yet: the hedged 'What helps {child}' claims from resolved reteach rows (they wait on learning-how-this-child-learns). Reverse if: parents read a lesson's lines as a judgement of the child.
